title: Felix and the Smile
author: Sable Reyes
blurb: Ivo Villalobos, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
